title: MineCarry
description: MineCarry allows players to pick up and move most vanilla container blocks while preserving all their contents. No more breaking chests and dropping items everywhere—just grab and relocate your storage safely and easily.
body:
# MineCarry

Tired of emptying containers just to move them?
MineCarry lets you pick up and relocate most vanilla containers with everything still inside. Move your storage quickly, safely, and without the mess.

How it works

## Pick up:
Sneak (Shift) + Right Click a supported container with an empty main hand.

## Carry:
The container is stored as a special marker item in your selected hotbar slot. While carrying it, you will have a movement speed penalty.

## Place:
Sneak (Shift) + Right Click on a block face to place it back down, fully restoring its BlockState and BlockEntity NBT (including inventory).

## Supported blocks

Chests (including double chests)
Barrels
Furnaces and other vanilla container blocks
Ender Chest (inventory remains per-player, as in vanilla)
Not supported

Shulker Boxes (intentionally excluded for balance and technical reasons)
Anti-duplication / safety
The carry marker item cannot be dropped
Prevents placing infinite empty containers
Overrides vanilla interaction to avoid GUI desync and duplication issues
Notes

## Designed for Forge 1.20.1
Works in both singleplayer and dedicated servers
